highlights.title: Cybersecurity Python Toolkit
highlights.summary: Three self-directed Python security tools built to practice hands-on SOC fundamentals, stdlib-only (hashlib, json, os, re, collections). File Integrity Checker: recursively SHA-256-fingerprints a target folder, saves a JSON baseline, and re-hashes on demand to report each file OK / CHANGED / MISSING — classic FIM logic. Password Strength Checker: scores an input 0-5 against length, uppercase, lowercase, digit, and symbol checks and prints a pass/fail breakdown with a verdict from 'Very Weak' to 'Excellent'. SSH Brute-Force Log Parser: regex-scans an auth log for 'Failed password' lines, extracts and tallies source IPs, and flags any IP over a configurable attempt threshold as a likely brute-force source.
metrics: FIM: SHA-256 fingerprinting in 8192-byte chunks, baseline + verify workflow
Brute-force parser: flagged 2 of 4 source IPs as attackers on a 41-line sample auth log (192.168.1.10 at 23 attempts, 10.0.0.5 at 13, threshold 10)

highlights.title: SOC Dashboard — Network Intrusion Monitor
highlights.summary: Local Security Operations Center dashboard built on the real CIC-IDS2017 network intrusion dataset — Postgres holds 2.83M labeled flows, Grafana renders dashboard-as-code panels with click-through filtering, and a Python ETL pipeline handles real data-quality issues in the raw dataset.
metrics: 4 click-through filter dimensions (day, attack type, port, class)

highlights.title: Mechanics & Heat Loss in ICE vs. EV Engines
highlights.summary: Cross-disciplinary Physics 2A final project analyzing why internal combustion engines lose roughly 80% of fuel energy to heat loss, using a 2021 Dodge Charger R/T 5.7L HEMI V8 as a real-world reference, then comparing that inefficiency against EVs using Phase Change Materials for thermal management. Delivered as a narrated video plus an interactive digital poster website with an embedded 3D engine explorer.
metrics: Interactive 3D ICE vs. EV engine explorer with quiz mode
Live companion site published for the class

media.altText: Interactive 3D Engine Explorer showing a cutaway ICE turbocharger model with a live part-info spec panel, from the ICE vs. EV Physics 2A companion site

highlights.title: Nexus Technologies IT Helpdesk Triage Agent
highlights.course: Google / Kaggle 5-Day AI Agents Intensive — Capstone (Agents for Business track)
highlights.summary: Multi-agent IT helpdesk triage system built on Google ADK 2.0 that routes support tickets to one of three paths: instant auto-resolve via keyword matching, security escalation via prompt-injection/phishing screening before any LLM call, or human review with two Gemini agents drafting a response. Includes a custom MCP tool server and a FastAPI supervisor dashboard. Built as the capstone for the Google/Kaggle 5-Day AI Agents Intensive.
metrics: 17 unit tests, no API key required
21 KB articles + 17 threat keywords + 7 prompt-injection patterns screened pre-LLM
